extracted.name: Green Goddess Dressing
extracted.description: This easy green goddess dressing is creamy, bright, and delicious! I most often make it with Greek yogurt, but it also works wonderfully with cashew cream. See the recipe notes below for this easy vegan variation.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup mixed soft leafy herbs (dill, mint, tarragon and/or cilantro)
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice (plus ½ teaspoon zest)
instruction_lines: In a food processor, combine the yogurt, parsley, mixed herbs, chives, lemon juice, zest, olive oil, capers, garlic, salt, and pepper. Pulse until well combined. Season to taste.
Serve as a dip or toss with salad greens. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
